name: Vertical Axis & Post-Surgical Integration Engine
subtitle: Shaoyang Gate / KD-SP Holding Field / CDR3 Integration Module
core_principle: Pain persists not because tissue is still damaged, but because the system failed to restore coherent transition between repair and function.
purpose: Detect whether the system failed to reintegrate after injury, surgery, exhaustion, or chronic overload.

primary_patterns.name: shaoyang_gate_dysfunction
triggers: post-surgical pain persisting beyond expected tissue healing timeline
pain worsened by transitions (morning, evening, temperature change, weather)
irritability and guarding without collapse presentation
neurovascular mismatch: nerve activity and microcirculation out of sync
CDR3 (cell danger response phase 3) integration failure
symptoms: burning, pulling, or deep aching pain
partial but non-sustained response to analgesics

red_flags_to_exclude: signs of infection, fever (check CRP, WBC)
mechanical tearing sensation or rapid deterioration

mechanism: fascial and water-grid fragmentation: local coherence slow to restore post-trauma, signals oscillate
neurovascular decoupling: neural activity and microcirculation desynchronised
protective guarding loop: fascia holds protective state, further degrading circulation and signal dampening
incomplete drainage: residual heat/pressure/emotional charge cannot discharge

foot is the ground-plane reference for the entire vertical axis; arch loss = field cannot hold itself

diagnosis_map.notes: Interpreted as CDR3 integration failure — system cannot return to rest-function transition after controlled trauma. Not active tissue damage. Neurovascular mismatch + fascial guarding loop + incomplete drainage.
Do not treat purely as neuropathy. Shaoyang gate dysfunction may mimic neuropathy. Distinguish by: response to transitions, guarding without collapse, oscillating rather than fixed pain.
Flat foot is a structural signal of KD-SP axis weakness. Not treated as isolated orthopaedic problem. Arch loss = loss of field self-holding. Whieda insole as reflexological-mechanical intervention.
Maps to KD deficiency. LWDHW for Yin-type adrenal fatigue (exhaustion + heat + dryness). Not appropriate if cold-dominant or digestive weakness predominates.

Head pain as upper pole overcompensation. Lower axis (KD/SP) does not receive and discharge. Heat above, cold below. Treat plantar zones and KD 1-3, SP 4-6 before addressing head GB points. Reflexology to sole effective in functional/tension/hormonal migraine; less so in acute structural or inflammatory causes.
Same lower-axis mechanism as migraine. Plantar reflexology effective as entry point.
Classic presentation of Shaoyang compensation for KD/SP field weakness.
Ligament tissue governed by Shaoyin-Taiyin holding field. Collagen structural support as Phase 3 adjunct.
Qi-collapse / prolapse dominant presentation: stabilise Qi before Yin nourishment. Huang Qi + Si Jun Zi Tang as base.

theoretical_framework_notes.summary: Reflexology zones carry neural-field representational information, not organ replacement. Plantar zones reflect vertical axis tension distribution. Small stimulus can have disproportionate effect if system is open/adaptive. Works better in chronic stuck states than acute destruction.

Foot is gravitationally anchored reference interface for entire vertical axis. KD-SP-BL state indicator. Treating plantar zones addresses upper pole overcompensation (headache, eye pressure, neck tension) by closing the axis loop below.

Meridians are embryologically fixed preferential tension-conduction directions within collagen-fascia continuum. Not discrete channels. Shaoyin (KD): anchors. Taiyin (SP): builds and holds. Shaoyang (GB/SJ): distributes and transitions.

Auriculo-therapy: embryological gill-arch remnant; vagus/trigeminus/facialis/glossopharyngeus junction; autonomic gateway; rapid reset effect. Different logic from plantar. Not currently mapped to engine patterns.
Retina is CNS tissue; eye reflexology zones have direct CNS connection; strong, fast, but potentially unstable. Precision instrument, not general application. Not currently mapped to engine patterns.

Cell danger response Phase 3: integration failure — system cannot transition from repair (Yin) to function (Yang). Caused by mitochondrial weakness, water-grid contamination with inactive metabolites, or fragmented water-grid. Key mechanistic model for post-surgical chronic pain.
Structured water in fascia-collagen continuum maintains and transmits tension pattern. Decoherence produces oscillating signals and incomplete drainage. Restoration target in Phases 1-2.
